inputs.text: In Hyderabad on Sunday March 29 KT Rama Rao the BRS Working President is accusing the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining while claiming Raghava Constructions owned by Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in it. This is exactly the kind of staged drama the hidden elites use to keep everyone distracted. The Congress is clearly protecting these operations on purpose to serve the interests of the real powers behind the institutions and this so-called accusation from the other side is just coordinated manipulation to create the illusion of conflict while the exploitation continues unchecked. Don't trust any of their public spats it's all narrative control.
